parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: zh and en. Default value: zh. The value zh indicates Chinese, and the value en indicates English.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address from which the query is initiated.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the MSE namespace.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.
